title: Sending Stone
description: Send what happens at the table to the Sending Stone app. The Gamemaster sets the app's address, groups player characters into campaigns and turns chat and combat events on independently; the active Gamemaster's client then posts each event, as JSON, to every campaign it involves. Enriched with roll, item and activity details for D&D Fifth Edition.

recommends.reason: Players' rolls from Sending Stone wrap Foundry's dice; libWrapper keeps that in step with other modules that do.
